description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different categories, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into four slices, labeled as "Right bias" in blue, "Left bias" in orange, "Questionable source" in green, and an unlabeled category in red. The proportions are 30% for "Right bias", 28% for "Left bias", 22% for "Questionable source", and 20% for the unlabeled red category. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, along with numerical values in parentheses, and does not have a visible legend. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting with "Right bias" at the top, and appear to be ordered from largest to smallest. No slices are visually emphasized.
